description: This file defines the BucketEndpointArnMiddleware class, which is a middleware component used in the AWS SDK for PHP to handle ARN-based endpoint resolution for S3 bucket access points. It includes logic for parsing ARNs, generating hostnames, and validating ARN configurations within the context of S3 operations.

classes.name: Aws\S3\BucketEndpointArnMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware for handling AWS S3 Bucket ARN parsing and endpoint URL modification based on ARNs within AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function for injecting the handler with service region and configuration details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for BucketEndpointArnMiddleware, setting up handler, service, region, config, and endpoint version indicator.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware execution method that processes the command and request, modifies request URI/host if ARN is detected, and handles validation and error scenarios.

methods.name: generateAccessPointHost
methods.description: Generates the hostname for an access point ARN, supporting various ARN types and configurations like Outposts, Object Lambda, and multi-region access points.

methods.name: validateArn
methods.description: Validates an ARN object, ensuring compatibility with current configuration and region constraints, and returns the corresponding partition object.

methods.name: isGlobal
methods.description: Checks if the provided region is considered a global region for S3.
